Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Add Product Insights Dashboard: 4 new analytics pages

Implemented comprehensive Product Insights section with 4 new dashboard pages:

New Pages:
- ❤️ Health Check: Support health overview with ticket volume trends, resolution time KPIs, sentiment analysis, and urgency breakdown
- 💡 Product Opportunity: Identifies friction areas with problem area analysis, root cause charts, feature mentions parser, and pain points table
- 🔬 Deep Dive Explorer: Advanced filtering system with multi-dimensional filters, paginated data tables, and export capabilities
- 💼 Business Impact: Quantifies business impact with gauge charts, recurring issues tracking, platform distribution, and critical issue prioritization

Features:
- Interactive Plotly charts (line, bar, pie, treemap, gauge)
- Real-time filtering and data updates
- CSV export functionality
- Color-coded urgency/severity indicators
- Responsive layouts with Streamlit
- Parse semicolon-delimited features
- Pagination for large datasets
- Date range filtering

Technical:
- Added chardet dependency for CSV encoding detection
- Created test_pages_loading.py for page validation
- All pages follow existing architecture patterns
- Compatible with existing tickets.csv data structure
